description_zh:
1) 痛點與核心賣點
本套為喜歡啃咬、需室內放電的犬隻準備，集合三款硬質、耐咬的天然零食，提供長時間咀嚼刺激，適合作為日常獎勵或咀嚼選擇。

2) 核心產品特色
• 三款硬核耐咬組合：高山犛牛芝士棒（M）×1、長條牛大筋 ×3、天然原隻牛蹄 ×1，滿足長時間啃咬需求。
• 全天然材質標示：產品以犛牛奶熟成芝士、100% 日本國產牛大筋與天然牛蹄為原料（各單品以原廠標示為準）。
• 長效咀嚼設計：硬度高、咀嚼時間長，適合在室內消耗精力與提供咀嚼刺激。
• 使用與處理提示包含：芝士棒可微波處理（原文建議微波 45 秒膨脹），並於啃咬至最後 2–3 cm 時取走以避免誤食整塊。

3) 規格與購買資訊
• 內容物：喜馬拉雅高山犛牛天然潔齒芝士棒 M號 1 本、天然牛大筋（特長）3 本、天然原隻牛蹄 1 隻。
• 產地：日本（Best Partner 原廠製造；犛牛芝士棒產地依原廠標示）。
• 淨重：共 3 件；現有資料未提供三款合計克數，以包裝標示為準。
• 原材料：天然犛牛奶熟成芝士、100% 日本國產牛大筋、天然牛蹄（以單品包裝標示為準）。
• 粗蛋白質／粗脂肪：各單品分析值以原廠單品標示為準。
• 條碼／SKU：MOFU-BUNDLE-DENTAL-02

4) FAQ
Q1：此套裝包含哪些單品？
A1：套裝內含：喜馬拉雅高山犛牛天然潔齒芝士棒 M 號 ×1、天然牛大筋（特長）×3、天然原隻牛蹄 ×1。

Q2：餵食或使用時有何注意事項？
A2：啃咬時請務必在飼主視線監護下進行，避免整塊吞嚥；芝士棒啃至最後 2–3 cm 時請取走。原始說明有提到芝士棒微波 45 秒可膨脹，若要依此處理請遵照包裝與微波安全指示並放涼後再餵食。
description_en:
1) Pain points & core selling point
This bundle is designed for dogs that enjoy chewing and need indoor activity. It combines three hard, long-lasting natural chews to provide extended chewing stimulation, suitable as a daily reward or chewing option.

2) Key product features
• Three hard-chew items: Himalayan yak cheese stick (M) ×1, long beef tendon sticks ×3, natural whole beef hoof ×1, offering prolonged chewing time.
• Natural ingredients as labeled: yak milk cheese (aged/smoked), 100% Japan-sourced beef tendon, and natural beef hoof (individual items as per manufacturer labeling).
• Long-lasting chew design: high hardness and extended chew time to help expend energy and provide oral chewing stimulation.
• Handling notes included: the cheese stick can be microwaved (original info suggests 45 seconds to expand); remove the last 2–3 cm of the cheese stick during chewing to avoid accidental ingestion of small whole pieces.

3) Specifications & purchase information
• Contents: Himalayan yak cheese stick M ×1, long beef tendon sticks ×3, natural whole beef hoof ×1.
• Origin: Japan (manufactured by Best Partner; yak cheese stick origin per manufacturer labeling).
• Net weight: 3 items total; current information does not provide combined grams — refer to packaging for exact weight.
• Ingredients: yak milk cheese (aged), 100% Japan beef tendon, natural beef hoof (refer to each product’s packaging).
• Crude protein / crude fat: nutritional analysis values are provided on the individual product labels by the manufacturer.
• Barcode / SKU: MOFU-BUNDLE-DENTAL-02

4) FAQ
Q1: What items are included in the bundle?
A1: The bundle includes: Himalayan yak cheese stick (M) ×1, long beef tendon sticks ×3, and natural whole beef hoof ×1.

Q2: Any feeding or usage precautions?
A2: Always supervise chewing to avoid whole-piece ingestion. Remove the last 2–3 cm of the cheese stick during use. The original product notes mention microwaving the cheese stick for 45 seconds to expand it—if following that instruction, adhere to packaging and microwave safety guidance and let it cool before offering.

2) 核心產品特色：
・原文標示第一主成分：100% 日本北海道野生蝦夷鹿肉（エゾ鹿）。
・低敏無穀配方：標示無小麥、無玉米、無大豆，訴求降低常見穀物來源的敏感風險。

・原產地（原文）：日本（國產・北海道產，Made in Japan）
・淨重／包裝：原始說明標示 800g（含保鮮密封夾鏈）；系統規格欄位為 400g。請以實際包裝標示為準。
・條碼 (JAN)：4976064026743
・主要成分（原文）：北海道產野生蝦夷鹿肉、玄米、大麥、紅蘿蔔、南瓜、啤酒酵母、礦物質、維生素群

・保存建議（原文）：置於乾燥陰涼處保存；包裝附保鮮夾鏈（依包裝標示）。

4) FAQ：
Q1：適合哪些年齡或品種？
A1：原始資料標示為「全齡犬」且描述顆粒適合全犬種咬合；標籤亦提到貓狗兼用。購買或使用前請以包裝或廠方建議為準。

Q2：如何換糧與保存？
A2：原文建議首次換糧時以 7–10 天循序漸進混合舊糧；保存請置於乾燥陰涼處並使用包裝密封夾鏈保存。

description_zh:
1) 痛點與核心賣點：
為尋找低敏替代蛋白與日常餵食選擇的毛孩設計，以日本國產馬肉作為主要蛋白來源，標示不含雞肉與牛肉，適合作為日常主食或獎勵／拌料使用。

2) 核心產品特色：
・以日本國產馬肉為主要蛋白來源，配方標示未添加雞肉或牛肉；訴求單一蛋白來源以提供低敏選擇。 
・無小麥、無玉米、無麩質，並搭配玄米、大麥與日本時令蔬菜（如紅蘿蔔、南瓜）與啤酒酵母等天然食材。 
・不添加化學誘食劑、漂白劑或人工防腐劑，採烘焙製程呈現食材原香，顆粒直徑約 8–10 mm，酥脆乾爽、顆粒適中。 
・適合乾餵或以溫水泡軟餵食，可與冷凍馬肉碎或馬肉鬆等搭配升級餐點（作為餵食選擇）。

3) 規格與購買資訊：
・品名 / 品牌：馬肉のごはん｜Best Partner
・規格：400g（原始資料描述中亦提及 800g，請以實際包裝標示為準）
・條碼（JAN）：4976064026477；包裝含保鮮密封夾鏈（原始資料記載）。
・主要成分：日本國產馬肉、玄米、大麥、紅蘿蔔、南瓜、啤酒酵母、礦物質群、維生素群（以包裝標示為準）。
・保證分析值：粗蛋白質 22.0% 以上、粗脂肪 8.0% 以上、粗纖維 3.0% 以下、粗灰分 5.0% 以下、水分 10.0% 以下；熱量：約 350 kcal / 100g（依原始資料）。

Q1：此產品適合對雞肉過敏的寵物嗎？
A1：產品配方以馬肉為主要蛋白，且原始資料標示未含雞肉與牛肉，適合作為尋找替代蛋白的選擇；若寵物曾有嚴重過敏反應，仍建議先諮詢獸醫再行更換。 

Q2：如何換糧與保存？
A2：原始資料建議換糧採 7–10 天過渡期逐步混合舊糧；保存請置於陰涼乾燥處，避免高溫多濕，開封後密封並於 1 個月內食用完畢（依包裝標示為準）。
description_en:
1) Pain points & core selling point:
Designed for pet owners seeking an alternative protein and low-allergen option. This product uses Japan-sourced horse meat as the primary protein and is presented as a chicken- and beef-free formula suitable for everyday feeding or as a reward/meal topper choice.

2) Key product features:
・Primary protein from Japan-sourced horse meat; formula is indicated as not containing chicken or beef, providing a single-protein option. 
・Grain-free claims regarding wheat and corn, and includes brown rice, barley and seasonal Japanese vegetables such as carrot and pumpkin, plus brewer's yeast and added vitamins/minerals. 
・No chemical appetizing agents, bleaching agents or artificial preservatives stated; baked to preserve natural aroma. Kibble diameter approximately 8–10 mm, crisp and medium-sized. 
・Can be fed dry, soaked in warm water to soften, or mixed with frozen horse meat crumbles or horse meat flakes to enhance a meal (as a feeding option).

3) Specifications & purchase information:
・Product / Brand: 馬肉のごはん｜Best Partner
・Size: 400g (the original description also refers to an 800g version; please refer to actual packaging for the correct size).
・Barcode (JAN): 4976064026477; packaging noted to include a resealable zipper (as stated in the source). 
・Main ingredients: Japan-sourced horse meat, brown rice, barley, carrot, pumpkin, brewer's yeast, mineral and vitamin groups (refer to packaging). 
・Guaranteed analysis: Crude protein 22.0% or more, crude fat 8.0% or more, crude fiber 3.0% or less, crude ash 5.0% or less, moisture 10.0% or less; Energy: approx. 350 kcal / 100g (per source).

4) FAQ (two items):
Q1: Is this suitable for pets with chicken allergies?
A1: The formula lists horse meat as the primary protein and indicates no chicken or beef; it can be considered as an alternative protein option. For pets with a history of serious allergic reactions, consult your veterinarian before switching. 

Q2: How should I transition and store the food?
A2: The source recommends a 7–10 day gradual transition when changing diets; store in a cool, dry place away from heat and humidity, keep sealed after opening and consume within one month (follow packaging instructions).
